You see a mana potion.
It weighs 2.70 oz.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 75 and 125 Mana Points, around 100 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Mana Point and Capacity Taken per Mana Point

History

  • The price was increased from 50 gp to 56 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 125x Mana Potions went from 5 Tibia Coins to 6 Tibia Coins.
    • 300x Mana Potions went from 10 Tibia Coins to 12 Tibia Coins.
